item.title: Fog disrupts Delhi airport operations; 118 flights cancelled, 16 diverted
item.description: NEW DELHI: At least 118 flights were cancelled, 16 flights diverted and 130 services delayed at the Delhi airport on Tuesday as dense fog disrupted operations. The Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGIA), operated by DIAL, handles around 1,300 flights daily. An official said 60 arrivals and 58 departures were cancelled while 16 flights were diverted [...]

item.title: BNP declares 7 days of mourning after death of Khaleda Zia
item.description: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) on Tuesday declared seven days of official mourning following the death of its chairperson and former prime minister Khaleda Zia.
